issue.title: node_finder_i_hidden PNG golden captures nondeterministically (4 distinct hashes across verify samples)

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by sase-1b1.4 note #4 (epic sase-1b1 chrome phase). While regenerating about 174 deck goldens, that phase saw node_finder_i_hidden produce 4 distinct PNG hashes across the fix-tui-screenshots verify samples on an unchanged tree. It left the golden untouched and stash-verified the instability on its clean base. The badge work does not touch the node finder.

Independent check by the sase-1b1 land agent at master 372ecc97c3: a targeted `just test-visual -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_node_finder.py::test_node_finder_i_hidden_png_snapshot` passed once (visual run 216afafd6219480a88d3595daad3a64f). So the instability is intermittent: the fail rate is unknown and was seen only in multi-sample verify under full-run load. Next step: capture several samples, diff them to find the unsettled region, and make the test wait on that condition.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1b1 chrome phase could not rebaseline this golden because verify samples disagreed; nothing tracks the instability, which leaves fix-tui-screenshots runs partial.
